artifact_observations.location: Center horizontal band across the tools
artifact_observations.reasoning: There is a distinct line of garbled, nonsensical text/watermark overlaying the middle of the toolbox contents. This is a common AI artifact or a low-quality source watermark that degrades image integrity.

The tools lack precise mechanical definition. Screwdriver shafts merge slightly into handles, and the hammer head lacks clear geometric separation between the claw and face. They look 'melted' or soft rather than rigid metal/plastic.
The background is an unnaturally uniform, flat pink with no depth or lighting variation, suggesting a synthetic or poorly lit studio setup typical of generated images.

To analyze the nonsensical text string in the center for OCR confidence and gibberish detection.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'text_gibberish' artifact. If the text is unreadable, it significantly impacts the quality score. Also, evaluate if the 'softness' of the tools indicates a failure in rendering rigid materials.
